import requests, re, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT="/agent/jobs/2b70b38c-2ea5-4319-89cb-da475f3f6965/provenance"

KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
        M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
AAs="ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"; POS=set("KR"); NEG=set("DE")

def get(acc): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
def usearch(q,cap=1500,fields="accession,organism_name,ft_signal,ft_transmem,sequence"):
    out=[];r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"size":500,"format":"tsv","fields":fields},timeout=180)
    while True:
        L=r.text.rstrip("\n").split("\n");hdr=L[0].split("\t");out+=[l.split("\t") for l in L[1:]]
        nx=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not nx or len(out)>=cap: break
        r=requests.get(nx,timeout=180)
    return pd.DataFrame(out[:cap],columns=hdr)

def feats(seq,win=19,scan=70):
    s=seq[:scan];kd=np.array([KD.get(c,0.) for c in s]);best=(0,-99)
    for i in range(0,len(s)-win+1):
        m=kd[i:i+win].mean()
        if m>best[1]: best=(i,m)
    i0,hmax=best;c=i0+win//2;L=c
    while L>0 and (kd[L-1]>0 or (L-2>=0 and kd[L-2]>0)): L-=1
    R=c
    while R<len(s)-1 and (kd[R+1]>0 or (R+2<len(s) and kd[R+2]>0)): R+=1
    n=s[:L];h=s[L:R+1]
    return dict(h_start=L+1,h_end=R+1,h_len=len(h),hmax19=hmax,n_len=len(n),
                n_charge=sum(ch in POS for ch in n)-sum(ch in NEG for ch in n),
                h_polar=sum(ch in "STNQYGCHDEKRP" for ch in h))

spdf=usearch('(reviewed:true) AND (taxonomy_id:2759) AND (ft_signal_exp:*) AND (length:[150 TO 900])')
sadf=usearch('(reviewed:true) AND (taxonomy_id:2759) AND (ft_transmem:"Signal-anchor for type II membrane protein") AND (length:[150 TO 900])')
def build(df,col,key,lab,maxstart=10**9):
    rows=[]
    for _,r in df.iterrows():
        m=re.search(key+r" (\d+)\.\.(\d+)",r[col] or "")
        if not m or len(r["Sequence"])<80: continue
        if int(m.group(1))>maxstart: continue
        f=feats(r["Sequence"]); f["klass"]=lab; f["acc"]=r["Entry"]; f["cl"]=int(m.group(2)); f["seq"]=r["Sequence"]
        rows.append(f)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
SP=build(spdf,"Signal peptide","SIGNAL","signal"); SA=build(sadf,"Transmembrane","TRANSMEM","anchor",45)

# PWM
def pwm(sites,bg):
    M=np.zeros((16,20))
    for s in sites:
        for i,c in enumerate(s): M[i,AAs.index(c)]+=1
    M=(M+1.)/(M.sum(1,keepdims=True)+20.); return np.log(M/bg)
tr=[r["seq"][r["cl"]-13:r["cl"]+3] for _,r in SP.iterrows() if r["cl"]>=14 and len(r["seq"])>r["cl"]+3]
tr=[s for s in tr if len(s)==16 and set(s)<=set(AAs)]
allseq="".join(SP["seq"]); bg=np.array([allseq.count(a) for a in AAs],float); bg/=bg.sum()
M=pwm(tr,bg)
def sc(seq,c):
    w=seq[c-13:c+3]
    return sum(M[i,AAs.index(ch)] for i,ch in enumerate(w)) if len(w)==16 and set(w)<=set(AAs) else np.nan
true_s=np.array([sc(r["seq"],r["cl"]) for _,r in SP.iterrows()]); true_s=true_s[~np.isnan(true_s)]
dec=[];
for _,r in SP.iterrows():
    for cc in range(14,min(61,len(r["seq"])-3)):
        if cc!=r["cl"]:
            v=sc(r["seq"],cc)
            if not np.isnan(v): dec.append(v)
thr=np.percentile(dec,99)

PAN={"Q9UTR0":("S. pombe Sil1","#d1495b"),"A0AAF0AWX6":("S. osmophilus Sil1","#2e86ab"),
     "S9PXT1":("S. octosporus Sil1","#4ea8c7"),"S9VUR3":("S. cryophilus Sil1","#7fc3d9"),
     "Q08199":("S. cerevisiae Sil1","#6a994e"),"Q9H173":("H. sapiens SIL1","#386641"),
     "P16474":("S. cerevisiae Kar2 (SP)","#9a8c98"),"P07306":("H. sapiens ASGR1 (anchor)","#403d39")}
seqs={a:get(a) for a in PAN}
QF=pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=a,name=PAN[a][0],**feats(seqs[a])) for a in PAN])
QF["pwm_best"]=[max([sc(seqs[a],c) for c in range(14,61)]) for a in QF["acc"]]
QF["pwm_bestpos"]=[int(np.nanargmax([sc(seqs[a],c) for c in range(14,61)])+14) for a in QF["acc"]]
QF.to_csv(f"{OUT}/sil1_panel_summary.csv",index=False)

# ---------------- FIGURE ----------------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,9))
# A hydropathy
a=ax[0,0]
for acc in ["Q9UTR0","A0AAF0AWX6","S9PXT1","S9VUR3"]:
    s=seqs[acc][:70]; kd=np.array([KD.get(c,0.) for c in s])
    sm=np.convolve(kd,np.ones(9)/9,mode="valid")
    a.plot(range(5,5+len(sm)),sm,label=PAN[acc][0],color=PAN[acc][1],lw=2)
a.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=.7); a.axvspan(20,42,color="#d1495b",alpha=.12)
a.set_xlabel("residue"); a.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle (window 9)")
a.set_title("A  Hydropathy, Schizosaccharomyces Sil1 N-termini\n(shaded: UniProt TRANSMEM 20-42 call for S. pombe)")
a.legend(fontsize=8)
for acc,cl in [("A0AAF0AWX6",26),("S9PXT1",27),("S9VUR3",26)]:
    a.plot([cl],[0],marker="v",color=PAN[acc][1],ms=8)
a.text(26,0.35,"SignalP cleavage\n(sister species)",fontsize=7,ha="center")

# B reference scatter
b=ax[0,1]
b.scatter(SP["n_charge"]+np.random.default_rng(0).normal(0,.12,len(SP)),SP["hmax19"],s=6,alpha=.25,color="#2e86ab",label=f"signal peptide (exp., n={len(SP)})")
b.scatter(SA["n_charge"]+np.random.default_rng(1).normal(0,.12,len(SA)),SA["hmax19"],s=6,alpha=.25,color="#e09f3e",label=f"type II signal anchor (n={len(SA)})")
for _,r in QF.iterrows():
    b.scatter(r["n_charge"],r["hmax19"],s=110,marker="*",color=PAN[r["acc"]][1],edgecolor="k",zorder=5)
    b.annotate(r["name"],(r["n_charge"],r["hmax19"]),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,4),textcoords="offset points")
b.set_xlabel("n-region net charge"); b.set_ylabel("max mean KD over 19-residue window")
b.set_title("B  N-terminal feature space"); b.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right"); b.set_xlim(-4,10)

# C PWM cleavage scores
c=ax[1,0]
c.hist(dec,bins=80,density=True,alpha=.45,color="grey",label="decoy positions")
c.hist(true_s,bins=60,density=True,alpha=.55,color="#2e86ab",label="true cleavage sites")
c.axvline(thr,ls="--",color="k",lw=1); c.text(thr,0.12,"  decoy 99th pct",fontsize=7)
for acc in ["Q9UTR0","A0AAF0AWX6","S9PXT1","S9VUR3","Q08199","Q9H173","P16474"]:
    v=QF.loc[QF.acc==acc,"pwm_best"].values[0]
    c.axvline(v,color=PAN[acc][1],lw=2.2 if acc=="Q9UTR0" else 1.2)
c.annotate("S. pombe Sil1\nbest site 3.6",(QF.loc[QF.acc=="Q9UTR0","pwm_best"].values[0],0.17),fontsize=8,color="#d1495b",ha="right")
c.set_xlabel("von Heijne-style cleavage-site PWM score"); c.set_ylabel("density")
c.set_title("C  Cleavage-site score (PWM trained on experimental eukaryotic SPs)"); c.legend(fontsize=8)

# D AlphaFold pLDDT
d=ax[1,1]
afd=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/sil1_alphafold_nterm.csv")
afd=afd.dropna(subset=["mean_pLDDT"]).sort_values("mean_pLDDT")
cols=["#d1495b" if "pombe" in n else ("#e09f3e" if "anchor" in n else "#2e86ab") for n in afd["name"]]
d.barh(afd["name"],afd["mean_pLDDT"],color=cols)
d.set_xlabel("mean AlphaFold pLDDT of N-terminal hydrophobic segment")
d.set_title("D  AlphaFold confidence: cleaved SPs (blue) vs type II anchors (orange)")
d.tick_params(labelsize=7)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(QF[["name","n_len","n_charge","h_start","h_end","h_len","hmax19","h_polar","pwm_best","pwm_bestpos"]].round(2).to_string(index=False))
print("\ndecoy 99th pct threshold:",round(thr,2)," median true site:",round(float(np.median(true_s)),2))
print("ref medians  SP: n_charge",SP['n_charge'].median()," hmax",round(SP['hmax19'].median(),2),
      "| anchor: n_charge",SA['n_charge'].median()," hmax",round(SA['hmax19'].median(),2))
